scope: Six fixed local PDFs, full main text, references, captions and embedded appendices. No external supplementary-video audit and no robot execution.

claims.claim: 21 single-motion tracking policies; sim2sim is not physical real-robot evidence.

claims.claim: Configuration limit enabled; velocity limit optional; solver damping and FrameTask damping differ.
64-D universal token conditions a proprioceptive control decoder; 29 joint targets are not an open-loop trajectory decoder output.
51.67% is a four-task mean partial progress score, not full-task success; online IK diagnostics are not policy evaluation.
Curtain at 200 demonstrations is 53.33; a text-extraction ordering artifact was resolved against the original plot.
44-D state combines controller-rollout body/gravity with geometric hand estimates. Canonical reuse does not establish cross-embodiment transfer.
Joint latency is 580 ms; principal Fast-WAM variant is 190 ms. Action cannot attend future video during either training or inference.
Real towel-folding points are graphical estimates, about 75% for Fast-WAM and 90% for IDM; pretrained pi0.5 is strongest. Raw trial counts not supplied.
Future-video conditioning remains at inference; reported 220 ms lacks enough hardware context for a strict same-device comparison with Fast-WAM.

teachingOnly: GMR scalar weighted-least-squares slider is not a G1 simulator or official GMR reimplementation.
